 .....

Resp
 Through: Mr. Pankaj Seth, Adv. for R-1.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Rekha Palli
 Order

The present appeal preferred by the claimants under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Tribunal vide the impugned award dated 05.01.2023.

2. Taking into account that no recovery rights have been granted under the impugned award, notice is required to be issued only to respondent no. 1.
3.
Mr. Seth accepts notice on behalf of respondent no. 1.
He prays for and is granted one week's time to make submissions.
4. In the meanwhile, TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
